title: Voyage
tagline: Voyage is a DApp for Travelers to mint Voyage NFTs, register Memories from travels as Lens posts and get DeFi rewards from destinations visited.
description:
Voyage starts with the Passport contract where you can set a destination, an starting and ending date for your travel and mint it as a Voyage NFT to record memories like photos, videos or audios posted on Lens Protocol while is active. 

Travelers with an active Voyage NFTs will be able to set a price to collect the content generated during the travel, if the Traveler is a person verified on Worldcoin, they will be able to get an income stream from fees collected on voyage minting and posting on Lens api while the voyage is active. 

Verified Travelers will also have access to Voyage Activities to get income streams by completing the activities and get Energy rewards if they regenerative and/or sustainable activities.

Any user will be able to track Travelers and Destinations leaderboard to evaluate preference between cities, activities and find income stream opportunities.
how_its_made:
Voyage is a web3 dapp built with:
Voyage Smart contracts: solidity with hardhat 
Contracts deployed and NTFs minted on Polygon Mumbai.
Web3 wallet: Wallet Connect and desktop wallet.
City stream: Superfluid.
Human verification: Worldcoin.
Frontend: Nuxt with Tailwind, 
API : Lens API, and The Graph.
IPFS
poap: Gnosis
